Sam (sales): Prospect asks for EU-only POC: tenant pinned to eu-central-1, BYOK in EU, telemetry never leaves EU, 24mo audit logs. Need concise handoff for their procurement today.
Irene (se): Quick Q - do they require HSM import or is regional KMS sufficient?
Sam (sales): They insisted on customer HSM import.
Luca (eng): Hosted supports EU KMS (eu-west-1) but HSM import requires Dedicated/Private so keys live in customer's KMS. Routing policy we use: pin primary = eu-central-1, failover = [eu-west-1], egress restrict to allowed regions.
Pat (sre): Subprocessors: compute/storage in EU (aws/gcp/azure EU regions). Monitoring defaults to US vendor — we can disable and route metrics to EU-only observability for POC. Ops ticket created.
OpsBot: Ticket #8342 "eu-poc-residency-lock" assigned to Luca. ETA 48h.
Maria (legal): I'll need subprocessors export + DPA addendum for 24mo retention and deletion proof.
Irene (se): Drafting 1-pager with routing snippet, BYOK options, peering checklist, and ballpark quote (~$15k 2-week POC hosted; +$10k/mo for Dedicated BYOK). Will upload to Drive and post link.
Sam (sales): Great — I'll collect CIDR & SIG questionnaire from customer and loop Maria. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
